patch:
diff --git a/inflection/__init__.py b/inflection/__init__.py
index ffac5ce22e60816f18267d742455e4936b6d1c1a..6622ab9e0784c8223f4417a103a5311fa0005ad6 100644
--- a/inflection/__init__.py
+++ b/inflection/__init__.py
@@ -370,12 +370,34 @@ def titleize(word: str) -> str:
       'The Man Without A Past'
       >>> titleize("raiders_of_the_lost_ark")
       'Raiders Of The Lost Ark'
+      >>> titleize("NASA rocket launch")
+      'NASA Rocket Launch'
+      >>> titleize("read the HTTP spec")
+      'Read The HTTP Spec'
+
+    All-caps acronyms (two or more capital letters) are preserved as written.
 
     """
-    return re.sub(
+    # Shield acronyms from underscore()/humanize(), which lowercase everything.
+    acronyms = []
+
+    def shield(match: "re.Match[str]") -> str:
+        acronyms.append(match.group(0))
+        return "zzacro%dzz" % (len(acronyms) - 1)
+
+    shielded = re.sub(r"(?<![A-Za-z])[A-Z]{2,}(?![a-z])", shield, word)
+
+    result = re.sub(
         r"\b('?\w)",
         lambda match: match.group(1).capitalize(),
-        humanize(underscore(word)).title()
+        humanize(underscore(shielded)).title()
+    )
+
+    return re.sub(
+        r"zzacro(\d+)zz",
+        lambda match: acronyms[int(match.group(1))],
+        result,
+        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
     )
